newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cisco EPS outlook cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cisco EPS outlook cut.

text.p: -- First Albany analyst Matt Barzowskas said he cut his earnings outlook for Cisco Systems Inc's fiscal 1997 and 1998 years and retained his neutral rating on the stock.
-- The analyst cited near-term concerns about Cisco's Japanese and European operations for the lowered earnings outlook.
-- He said he cut his fiscal 1997 year earnings outlook to $2.05 per share from $2.11 and his 1998 outlook to $2.77 from $2.88 per share previously.
-- The stock was off 1-5/16 at 49-1/4 in mid-morning trading Monday on volume of 4.0 million shares.
-- In published comments, the analyst wrote that the near-term situation in Japan "is not improving," and "will continue to put near-term pressure on earnings."

-- He cited META Group research that shows Cisco has had some problems with its European distribution channels and that as a result the company has become much more aggressive about product pricing, putting pressure on near-term earnings.

-- "Additionally, the company's European business has been struggling, as the demand for overall networking has slowed and Cisco is trying to jump start its performance in the distribution channels," Barzowskas said.
-- He noted that Cisco derives almost 50 percent of its revenues from overseas, including about 10 percent from Japan.
